## Question/help

### If you want to edit the mod

Remove / edit
required : 7zip https://www.7-zip.org/

If you dont want some features of the mod, **7zip** let u open the fantome directly so go get **7zip** and open the fantom with it to do the delete things
> all thoses are stored in the WAD folder

Thoses are for deleting the whole feature / champion edits, but you can go into the files and remove only some (you will need to check the skin id to find out which skin use which files)

>This web site let you know the id per skins : https://martynasxs.dev/skindb

To remove the **old sumonners spells mod**:
> Remove the file named DATA.wad.client

To remove an **old champ icons / hud** :
> Remove the file named INSERT_CHAMP_NAME.wad.client
>> e.g : to remove Olaf old icons remove the file named olaf.wad.client

To remove some **item and edit** the item mod :
> Get into the item.wad.client

If you know how to edit mods, files are just wad folder so just open the zip file and do what u want to do in it

Hope you enjoy
